question: Does every admitted packed-Q8 descriptor execute the qualified four-column arithmetic with correct logical outputs/state, and does every unsupported or failed execution have the declared rejection/invalidation behavior?
prerequisites: Use the exact frozen model/core/frontend/compiler/modules and device identity for the intended comparison; record all hashes and architecture flags.
Use actual captured model projection operands and descriptors, with independently replayable old four-column/tail paths.
Keep source/binary changes for a prospective guard isolated from the already qualified baseline; this design supplies no authorization to label new binaries qualified.
Record source, build and loaded-module identity separately from data-dependent shape, stride, padding and actual allocation/device descriptors.
descriptor_fields_to_record: actual buffer type, buffer usage, buffer device, view_src and allocation-vs-data byte size
CUDA device compute capability and warp size
op, precision hint, IDs and fusion presence
outer q, arithmetic columns a=4, independent channel count g, first_tail and each tail width
actual dispatcher route for the grouped node and every old tile
activation quantizer type/configuration and quantized row identity
MMVQ type specialization, ncols_dst, channel/sample counts, row/column/channel/sample strides and integer offset spans
phase policy, live physical prefix vector, output mask and reserve
full structural recipe identity; hashes may label receipts but must not replace equality of admission fields

positive_cases.purpose: No multi-group packing; observed native four-column path remains the control.
First outer split and a one-column tail; packed branch still inactive.
One four-column tile and three-column tail without multi-group packing.
First actual packed mapping: [K,4,2], no tail.
Two packed groups plus one-column tail.
Two packed groups plus three-column tail.
Three packed groups with no tail.
Seven packed groups plus tail near the maximum width.
Maximum admitted outer width and eight groups.
Same outer query count on opposite sides of an actual physical padding boundary; compare W and L without changing projection recipe.
Commit an earlier accepted frontier while later verified rows are rejected; compare owned full vector and extracted active KV.

negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Reject as outside the packed recipe before native work, or name and separately qualify the ordinary fallback.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Noncontiguous activation with otherwise supported dtype/shape
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Explicit rejection or separately qualified graph-tile fallback; never infer compatibility from branch availability.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Noncontiguous weight or unsupported weight batch dimension
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Record exact route and stride predicate; reject if not in the admitted descriptor set.
Exercise the generic cuBLAS branch condition using safe diagnostic metadata/fixtures; unsupported reference recipe must be rejected rather than silently relabeled MMVQ.
Actual buffer admission must reject or use a separately qualified route; configuration intent is insufficient.
Reject at deployment admission. Do not execute fabricated device pointers or unsupported kernels to test this.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Precision hint, IDs, fused arithmetic or activation dtype differing from recipe
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Reject before numerical work unless specifically included in qualification.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Integer stride/offset span outside admitted range
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Reject with checked metadata arithmetic before allocation/launch; do not allocate huge tensors to provoke overflow.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Same outer shape but changed prefix vector or active/layout policy
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Graph reuse must reject/rebuild as specified; compare requested outputs/state after rebuilt execution.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Failure after an earlier native group/operator has executed
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Poison or terminate owner; no success result, no same-owner retry or next request.

negative_and_failure_cases.change: Trim/draft/sample failure caught by an embedding caller
negative_and_failure_cases.required_decision: Either prohibit continuation by a transaction-invalid flag or declare CLI process termination as the only supported failure contract.

required_evidence_layers.pass_condition: Predicates and rejection boundary are explicit and source-bound; unsupported descriptors have declared outcomes.
Every original four-column/tail path reproduces its captured output under the unchanged recipe.
Packed and backend-loop4 outputs, quantized activations and logical ordering satisfy the declared exact reference relation for each admitted captured descriptor.
Independent original-reference tokens, full requested vectors, extracted active KV, accepted frontier, trim and pending-token behavior agree for the declared cases.
Loaded modules, model, device and admitted descriptor/dispatch fingerprint match qualification while capture remains off; always-on guard cost is included.
Paired strong-baseline requests with complete resident-service cost, confidence intervals, warmup and control drift; no isolated operator percentage promoted to full-model gain.

forbidden_inferences: A static binding receipt is not a native correctness pass.
The four-column loop4 marker checks do not apply to unmarked packed nodes.
A clean observer bad=false value is not a placement observation.
One captured shape does not qualify all shapes accepted by a broader C++ branch.
Theoretical reduction preservation is a premise to test with the bound dispatcher, not proof that dispatch selected it.
Any speedup from relaxing output/state/reference requirements is outside this experiment.
